shortDescription: AI-powered trading insights, portfolio tracking, and market analysis.
fullDescription:
TradeVision AI helps traders and investors make smarter decisions with AI-powered market analysis, real-time quotes, and portfolio tracking.

Free tier includes basic market data and limited AI analyses. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited AI insights, advanced charting, real-time quotes, and an ad-free experience.

Features:
• AI market analysis and trade ideas
• Real-time market quotes (Premium)
• Portfolio tracking (Premium)
• Price alerts and push notifications
• Dark mode and customizable settings
